//@mdx-js/mdx: Declared rather than relied on as a transitive of @mdx-js/loader: it is imported directly by MdxRuntime (evaluate) and by the MDX guard's write-time check (createProcessor). Note its estree-walker dependency is import-only, so it must be reached via dynamic import from anything tsx compiles to CJS — the seed CLIs and the test runner.
//audit-esbuild: npm audit reports 4 moderate advisories for esbuild <=0.24.2 (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99) reached only via drizzle-kit -> @esbuild-kit/esm-loader -> @esbuild-kit/core-utils. Deliberately NOT fixed. (1) drizzle-kit is a devDependency: nothing here ships. (2) The advisory is about esbuild's DEV SERVER, which drizzle-kit never starts - it uses esbuild to transpile drizzle.config.ts. (3) @esbuild-kit/core-utils pins esbuild ~0.18.20, so an override to a patched line violates its own range; the top-level esbuild is already 0.25.12. (4) `npm audit fix --force` proposes drizzle-kit@0.18.1, a downgrade from 0.31.10 that would take the CMS migration tooling with it. Revisit when drizzle-kit drops @esbuild-kit (it is deprecated in favour of tsx). Check production exposure with `npm audit --omit=dev`, which reports 0.
//overrides: next 16.2.x pins its own nested sharp@0.34.5, which carries the libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj). Raising only the top-level copy leaves that one installed, so both are pinned here. Verified with a production build and a live /_next/image request.
